[[Kanaxai]] is a chaos [[demon]] of nightmares<ref name="Prima">Guild Wars Factions Prima Guide</ref> who dwells within [[the Deep]], beneath [[the Jade Sea]]. He is the leader of the [[Nightmare Horde]] comprised of [[Nightmare]]s, [[Oni]], and the maddened [[Outcast]]s. His exact origins and allegiances are unknown, though rumors across Cantha suggest his Oni come from the Mists,<ref>[[Conflict in Cantha]]</ref> though others speculate Oni are transformed Outcasts.<ref>[[Dauv Merishahl]]</ref> According to rumors, the Oni first appeared shortly after the [[Jade Wind]], which was when Kanaxai was trapped beneath the sea.<ref name="Prima"/><ref>[[Andru Pitrak]]</ref><ref name="Eurayle">[[Eurayle]]</ref>

When [[Luxon]] [[Reaver]]s delving deep into the Jade for high quality deposits discovered him, his influence drove them mad. They became [[Outcasts]], and they now serve as minions of his growing [[Nightmare Horde]].<ref name="Prima"/><ref name="Eurayle"/><ref>[[Outcasts in the Quarry]]</ref><ref>[[Jefri Whylir]]</ref>
